assets.title: Financial Literacy Requires Context
assets.alt: Illustrated financial planning desk with an open notebook and the words Financial Literacy Requires Context.
assets.caption: Financial literacy requires context. Start with household priorities, clear information and questions that fit your circumstances.

assets.title: Financial Stability Is Built Through Systems
assets.alt: Illustrated financial records, calculator and notebooks beneath the words Financial Stability Is Built Through Systems.
assets.caption: Financial stability is built through systems: organized records, regular review and practical routines for households and small businesses.

assets.title: Insurance Education
assets.alt: Insurance education graphic showing an umbrella over wooden family and home figures.
assets.caption: Insurance education starts with understanding coverage, exclusions and questions to ask. Availability and regulated services require current license and jurisdiction verification.

assets.title: Education First
assets.alt: Blue and gold Emerson Agency graphic reading Education First, People Over Profit.
assets.caption: Education first. People over profit. Explore practical financial learning that begins with people’s needs and informed decisions.

assets.caption: Blue Emerson Agency emblem

assets.title: Education Without Borders
assets.alt: Illustrated learning desk with a map, project notes and the words Education Without Borders.
assets.caption: Education without borders begins with clear learning goals, reliable communication and respect for different experiences.

assets.alt: Green and gold EPDG emblem with a crown above the initials.
assets.caption: Green EPDG emblem

assets.title: Documentation Is a Professional Skill
assets.alt: Learning desk illustration with a notebook and the words Documentation Is a Professional Skill.
assets.caption: Documentation is a professional skill. Record what you tried, the feedback you received and how your work developed.

assets.title: Professional Growth Happens in More Than One Room
assets.alt: Illustrated books and learning notes beneath the words Professional Growth Happens in More Than One Room.
assets.caption: Professional growth happens in more than one room: through study, practical projects, reflection and sharing work responsibly.

assets.title: The Classroom
assets.alt: Open study notebooks and books beneath the words The Classroom.
assets.caption: The classroom provides a foundation for asking questions, building understanding and preparing for practical work.

assets.title: The Project
assets.alt: Illustrated project briefs and notes beneath the words The Project.
assets.caption: The project connects learning to a defined task. A clear brief, documented choices and review help make the work useful.

assets.title: The Revision
assets.alt: Draft pages with marked revisions beneath the words The Revision.
assets.caption: The revision makes learning visible. Use feedback to refine a draft and explain the choices behind the next version.

assets.title: The Public Evidence
assets.alt: Illustrated portfolio folder and manuscript pages beneath the words The Public Evidence.
assets.caption: The public evidence is work shared with context: its purpose, methods and limits. This illustration does not depict a particular manuscript or event.

assets.title: Clear Expectations
assets.alt: Illustrated project brief and task list beneath the words Clear Expectations.
assets.caption: Clear expectations help learners understand the task, the feedback process and the next step in their development.
